args.title: Fix failures due to empty trailing lines in imported statement files
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Modify parseStatement to handle trailing empty lines gracefully by allowing an empty line at the end without treating it as a malformed row, preventing errors on the last row during import.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The error arises because parseStatement treats a trailing empty line as a malformed row due to mismatched columns count. The parser.ts file shows how the input is split into lines and verifies row shape. Adjusting parseStatement to ignore trailing empty lines fixes imports that end with a blank line without causing errors.
